tracks.title: 积木战争 V3-01｜夺桥·稳步推进
tracks.direction: 小提琴领奏，主推的均衡版本
tracks.energy_plan: 节奏引子 → 适中主段 → 八小节减法段 → 短暂提升 → 回落
tracks.prompt: Instrumental chamber-folk strategy battle cover, 126 BPM, steady 4/4. Retain the reference's rhythmic introductory feel, rephrase at this moderate tempo. Start with FOUR BARS of plucked cello, muted mandolin and soft frame-drum pulse; let the lead enter afterward. One warm mid-register fiddle states a simple memorable four-bar tune, five to seven main notes, short calls, held answers and clear rests. Preserve the core melodic contour, simplify ornamentation. Woodwind replies only in the gaps. Minor-key tension and firm rhythmic accents suggest contesting a bridge. Small ensemble, rounded attacks, moderate dynamics, clear separation. Shape energy in waves: quiet intro, medium main theme, eight bars reduced to plucks and a soft lead, a brief slightly fuller return, then settle. Add at most one layer at a time; melody stays clear above quiet percussion. Three-minute gameplay cue with breathing room and a loop-oriented close.

tracks.title: 积木战争 V3-02｜夺桥·木管号令
tracks.direction: 单簧管领奏，留白最多的版本
tracks.energy_plan: 轻节奏引子 → 木管短主题 → 稀疏回应 → 小幅回升 → 平稳收束
tracks.prompt: Instrumental intimate folk-chamber strategy battle cover, 120 BPM, purposeful 4/4. Keep the reference's rhythm-first entrance: four bars of plucked cello, muted mandolin and light woodblock establish the pulse before the tune. A warm mid-register clarinet is the only lead, presenting a compact four-bar hook with repeated notes, one expressive leap, a held reply and audible rests. Keep the reference's melodic identity but remove rapid flourishes. Fiddle answers briefly after each phrase, never doubling continuously. Minor-key call-and-response and firm accents keep a tactical combat feeling. Quiet frame drum sits behind the melody. Three or four active parts, rounded treble, natural dynamics and an uncluttered mix. Low intro, medium-low theme, a thinner eight-bar passage, a modest return, then ease back; keep this breathing cycle through three minutes. Clear memorable tune, measured motion, loop-oriented ending.

tracks.title: 积木战争 V3-03｜夺桥·轻装争夺

tracks.prompt: Instrumental lean acoustic strategy combat cover, 132 BPM, buoyant 4/4 with controlled momentum. Preserve the reference's rhythm-led opening: four bars of dry mandolin offbeats, plucked bass and gentle hand drum, then reveal the melody. Fiddle and a rounded wooden flute take turns as a single lead, never competing. Simplify the source tune into a memorable four-bar call-and-answer; short eighth-note gestures alternate with held notes and rests. Minor harmony and syncopated accents convey a nimble bridge skirmish. Keep accompaniment sparse, bass mostly on strong beats, percussion quiet and dry. Energy arc: restrained intro, medium theme, eight bars with half the backing removed, one brief eight-bar lift with a soft cello counterline, then return to the lean texture. Natural dynamic range, soft transients, open midrange; the hook remains easy to follow. Three-minute game cue, stable tempo, loop-oriented close.
